torch_before_on.source:
ldr w8,[x0,#0x30]
        cmp w8,#1
        b.ne original
        ldr w8,[x0,#0xbc]
        cmp w8,#1
        b.ne original
        cbnz w2,original
        adrp x9, 3170304; add x9,x9,#3200
        ldr w8,[x9]
        sub w8,w8,#1
        cmp w8,#8
        b.hi original
        bfi x1,x8,#0,#32
    original:
        b 0x2d79e0

custom_strength_context.source:
mov w8,#0x6810
        cmp w1,w8
        b.eq context
        add w8,w8,#1
        cmp w1,w8
        b.eq apply
        stp x29,x30,[sp,#-0x20]!
        b 0x229eb4
    context:
        ldr w8,[x0,#0x30]
        cmp w8,#1
        b.ne unsupported
        cmp x2,#9
        b.hi invalid
        adrp x9, 3170304; add x9,x9,#3200
        str w2,[x9]
        mov w0,#0
        ret
    apply:
        ldr w8,[x0,#0x30]
        cmp w8,#1
        b.ne unsupported
        sub x8,x2,#1
        cmp x8,#8
        b.hi invalid
        ldr w9,[x0,#0xbc]
        cmp w9,#1
        b.ne unavailable
        ldr x0,[x0,#0x2a8]
        cbz x0,unavailable
        ldr x9,[x0]
        ldr x9,[x9,#0x38]
        mov w1,w8
        br x9
    invalid: mov w0,#-22; ret
    unsupported: mov w0,#-38; ret
    unavailable: mov w0,#-19; ret
